name: Ornn Data
description:
Ornn Data tracks prices across the AI compute market. This connector gives
Claude read access to those series, so you can ask about them in conversation
instead of exporting data.

It covers:

- GPU compute: current prices, the daily settled index, price history,
  24-hour rolling averages, volatility, and traded volume for tracked types
  including H100 SXM, H200, A100 SXM4, B200, RTX 5090, and RTX PRO 6000 WS
- Memory: DRAM, flash, and module price indices and history
- AI tokens: the Ornn Token Price Index by lab, and the Token Volume Index
- LLM coding activity: current index values and history by product
- US wholesale power: PJM, MISO, ISO-NE, CAISO, WECC Northwest, WECC
  Southwest and ERCOT - latest daily prints and history back to 2017
- Neo-cloud datacenter sites, workload cost metrics, and forward curves.

Any Ornn account can connect. Public metrics are available to every account;
the full dataset and deeper history require a full-access account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ornn Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ornn Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://data.ornn.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ornn Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ornn Data lists 29 MCP tools, including fetch, get_daily_index, get_daily_index_snapshot, get_forward_curve, get_gpu_index_history, get_gpu_price, get_gpu_price_at, get_gpu_price_history, get_gpu_rolling_average, get_gpu_volatility, get_gpu_volume_metrics, and get_llm_coding_history.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ornn Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Ornn Data in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Ornn Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ornn Data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ornn Data is developed by Ornn AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
